output.summary: The decline tracks the forced move from Castellan Hall to Brightwater, which has 40% fewer seats and poor transit. Single-ticket sales fell 45% in the first year. Core subscribers who attend still renew at about 85%. Lapsed-patron reasons are mostly travel and parking. The downtown cathedral sells about 50% more tickets per concert. Per-concert sales do not differ with or without post-1945 works. Peers also lost a median 29% without moving venue, so the decline is partly regional. Marketing effect is unknown because nothing is tracked. Non-renewal would forfeit the $400k/season Halvorsen grant on a repertoire cause the evidence contradicts. Cutting new works would risk the $180k Arts Council grant. Best path: segmented analysis for the board, cathedral dates and a shuttle, and measurement of marketing.
